description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn sets out seven numbered decisions, each '**Topic:** proposed default', and asks the user to say the word to change any. That is one ask (accept the defaults, or reply to change some), so the card carries a few short whole-ask replies, never one button per list row quoting its sentence and number.
